events.title: Brisbane Makerspace Open Night
events.description: A recurring open night at the local makerspace where members and visitors can explore tools, robotics, and electronics in a collaborative environment. Ideal for tinkerers looking to meet others interested in hardware and DIY culture.

events.title: Mount Coot-tha Loop Summit to Summit
events.description: A community-led morning hike traversing the summit trails of Mount Coot-tha. This group provides an opportunity for casual conversation while engaging in local nature exploration.

events.title: Public Lecture: The Spiritual Secrets of the Medical Symbol The Caduceus
events.description: An exploration into the historical and esoteric symbolism of the Caduceus, hosted by the Brisbane Theosophical Society. This lecture aims to unpack symbolic meanings behind ancient medical iconography.

events.title: Karawatha Rocks Circuit
events.description: A group hiking excursion through the Karawatha Forest, designed to connect active locals through shared outdoor movement. Perfect for those who enjoy exploring Brisbane's natural trails in a social setting.
